content.json:
# Azure Local PoC

Cluster **AZL-CLUSTER-01** in resource group **rg-azlocal-poc-001**. This board is built from Azure Resource Graph (live, read-only). It shows the physical cluster nodes, the tenant VMs we run (with distro + version + health), and the cluster resource. Power state / private IP / image are not indexed by Resource Graph and are added in a later revision via an ARM data source.

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' and kind == '' | where name has 'AZLOCAL' | project Node=name, OS=tostring(properties.osSku), Build=tostring(properties.osVersion), Status=tostring(properties.status), Agent=tostring(properties.agentVersion) | order by Node asc
content.title: Cluster nodes

content.json: ## Tenant VMs by slot (auto-populates from whatever is loaded)

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' and kind =~ 'HCI' | project Slot=tostring(tags.slot), Role=tostring(tags.role), VM=name, Distro=tostring(properties.osSku), Kernel=tostring(properties.osVersion), Status=tostring(properties.status), Agent=tostring(properties.agentVersion) | order by Slot asc, VM asc
content.title: Tenant VMs (distro + version + health)

content.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.azurestackhci/clusters' | project Cluster=name, Status=tostring(properties.status), Location=location, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup
content.title: Azure Local cluster
